entities.name: Nicolas Durand de Villegaignon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolas Durand, sieur de Villegagnon, also Villegaignon was a commander of the Knights of Malta, and later a French naval officer who attempted to help the Huguenots in France escape persecution, before turning against them due to Eucharistic disputes.
